claims.claim: monday.com's GraphQL API endpoint is https://api.monday.com/v2 and uses an Authorization header carrying the API token.
claims.raw_snippet: https://api.monday.com/v2

claims.claim: As of August 2026 the default monday.com API version is 2026-07, used whenever no API-Version header is passed.
claims.raw_snippet: Used as the default version when no header is passed

claims.claim: monday.com guarantees at least three parallel API versions and ships a new version every quarter, which is why 2026-10 is the release candidate while 2026-04 is in maintenance.
claims.raw_snippet: We guarantee at least three different versions of the API in parallel and release a new version every quarter.

claims.claim: API versions 2024-10 and 2025-01 were deprecated on February 15th, 2026.
claims.raw_snippet: January 15th, 2025 February 15th, 2026

claims.claim: The boards query returns only classic boards unless hierarchy_type is passed or explicit board IDs are supplied, so multi-level (sub-item) boards are excluded by default rather than included.
claims.raw_snippet: If omitted, only `classic` boards will be returned unless specific board IDs are provided.

claims.claim: account.plan returns null for accounts on monday's multi-product infrastructure, so a verify step must not branch on plan; account.tier and account.products are the reliable fields.
claims.raw_snippet: The account's payment plan. Returns `null` for accounts with the multi-product infrastructure.

claims.claim: A personal API token gets a combined read plus write budget of 10M complexity points per minute.
claims.raw_snippet: Reads and writes have a combined budget of 10M points per minute

claims.claim: An app token is limited to 5M complexity points per minute for reads and 5M for writes separately, a different shape from the personal token's shared 10M pool.
claims.raw_snippet: Read and writes are limited to 5M complexity points per minute

claims.claim: Rate limit errors carry a retry_in_seconds field, and responses carry RateLimit-Policy and RateLimit headers.
claims.raw_snippet: Every rate limit error returns a `retry_in_seconds` field

claims.claim: The Rate Limit Exceeded error is a distinct 429 condition triggered by more than 5,000 requests in one minute, separate from the complexity budget.
claims.raw_snippet: You made more than 5,000 requests in one minute

claims.claim: ColumnValueException is returned with HTTP status 200, so a failed column write looks like a successful request unless the errors array is inspected.
claims.raw_snippet: Incorrect column value formatting

claims.claim: On a connect boards column the value field always returns null; read display_value, linked_item_ids or linked_items instead.
claims.raw_snippet: Always returns `null` for this column. Use `linked_items` and `linked_item_ids` instead.

claims.claim: Connect boards columns are written with an item_ids array, not a connection identifier argument.
claims.raw_snippet: item_ids

claims.claim: Mirror column values cannot be updated or cleared through the API because they reflect the source column on the connected board.
claims.raw_snippet: Mirror column values cannot be updated or cleared directly

claims.claim: Webhook registration requires echoing back a randomly generated token that monday sends in a challenge field.
claims.raw_snippet: sending a JSON POST body containing a randomly generated token as a `challenge` field

claims.claim: Failed webhook deliveries retry once a minute for 30 minutes and are then abandoned, so a reconciliation pass is still needed.
claims.raw_snippet: Requests sent through our webhook integration will retry once a minute for 30 minutes.

claims.claim: In API version 2026-07 the Query.users arguments kind, newest_first and non_active are deprecated in favour of user_kind, sort and status, an unlimited users query now returns 200 users, and the maximum limit is 1000; legacy User photo and boolean flag fields are removed in 2026-10.
claims.raw_snippet: user_kind

claims.claim: monday.com sells four products with separate plan ladders: work management (Free, Basic, Standard, Pro, Enterprise), CRM (Basic through Ultimate), Dev and Service; Free exists only on work management.
claims.raw_snippet: Ultimate

claims.claim: Standard is the first tier with automations and integrations, and it allows 250 actions per month; Pro allows 25,000 and Enterprise up to 250,000.
claims.raw_snippet: 250 actions / month

claims.claim: The plan caps daily API calls: 1,000 per day on Standard, 10,000 on Pro and 25,000 on Enterprise, which binds a polling integration long before the complexity budget does.
The monday.com marketplace is the authoritative place to check whether an integration app exists for a given Israeli accounting or ERP system before promising one.
claims.raw_snippet: marketplace

claims.claim: Custom automation triggers and actions are built via the monday apps framework; there is no queryable core-API automations endpoint.
claims.raw_snippet: API reference

claims.claim: Item queries use items_page with cursor-based pagination; items_page_by_column_values pages the same way and truncates silently at the limit if the cursor loop is omitted.
claims.raw_snippet: items_page
